# A pull request that changes any of these cannot merge until every machine
# in the real-machine workflow passes. On other pull requests the machines
# still run, and a failure is shown without blocking. One entry per line: a
# path ending in "/" means everything under that directory, anything else is
# one file. The list is read from the branch being merged into, so a change
# to it takes effect once it is merged.
#
# These are the parts of Shambles that decide where a login is read from and
# written to, and how the program reaches a stranger's machine. The fakes in
# the unit suite cannot say whether a change here still agrees with the real
# Keychain, the real Credential Manager or the vendors' own programs.

# Where a login is kept, per system.
shambles/stores/
shambles/providers/
shambles/paths.py

# How Shambles is installed and built.
scripts/
shambles/release_assets.py
pyproject.toml
.github/actions/build-binary/

# The Swift panel, which the workflow builds and tests.
macos/

# The workflow itself and what it runs.
.github/workflows/real-machine.yml
.github/real-machine-paths.txt
.github/scripts/real_machine_required.py
tests/real/
tests/release_server.py
